title: Defense of the Craft
description: Survival-oriented combat enhancement Dota 2 mod for Fabric Minecraft
body:
![Title with logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8a5246d72a7960b21a5bd33ea4737ecc5a081ce.png) ![Modrinth Followers](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/followers/defense-of-the-craft?style=for-the-badge) ![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/defense-of-the-craft?style=for-the-badge) ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/defense-of-the-craft?style=for-the-badge) Defense of the Craft (DOTC) is a survival-oriented combat enhancement Fabric mod for 1.21.1 which adds Dota 2 artifacts and mechanics to Minecraft. The core features of the mod are: * **Stats system** - strength, agility and intelligence * **Pseudo-random procs** - evasion, bash, crit, bonus damage * **New effects** - disarm, stun, break, silence, root, armor reduction * **50+ new items** - food, swords, axes and pickaxes * **New radiant and dire ores** in the overworld and nether dimensions * **Dota interface sounds** for screenshots, menus and commands * **Kill streaks** for player kills The mod is translated to *English*, and *Russian*. ## Dependencies * [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) * [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) * [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) ## F.A.Q. *Q:* I want to know more about mod items! *A:* Check out the mod [wiki](https://github.com/detectivekaktus/dotc/wiki)!
*Q:* Dota sounds don't work! *A:* By default they are turned off, you can enable them via ModMenu!
*Q:* When will other version ports come out? *A:* Right now version porting is not the priority and in the observable future it will not be one.
*Q:* Will you port this mod to Forge/Neoforge? *A:* Forge/Neoforge ports will never be done. ## Known incompatibilities * [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) ## Contributing I'm welcoming new contributors! If you're good at modeling, spriting or coding, check out the contributing guidelines and open pull requests with your changes. ## Notice This mod is not developed by or affiliated with Valve Corporation nor Mojang Studios. All Dota 2 and Steam assets are property of Valve Corporation.
